bug_semantics: Authenticated FileServer GET treats a missing ComponentId as Personal space and grants access (isUserAllowed returns true). Combined with TypeUpload, the servlet then serves an attacker-controlled absolute path via descriptor.absolutePath()/filePath=sourceFile without tying the file to a component instance (CWE-36 path traversal plus authorization bypass).
